html:
For high-quality window tinting in Townsville, you can’t go past Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. Below, find out about our window tinting Townsville based service and the types of film you can choose from for your home.

We offer car, home and office window tinting with stores located right across Australia, including Townsville. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for 50 years so we know our stuff! The films we use are exclusive to us (supplied by the world’s largest window film manufacturer) and they’re also government-certified by ARPANSA. Here are the films in our range and the benefits they offer

Window Tinting Townsville

With our window tinting Townsville based service, a consultant will come out to your home to do a measure and quote for tinting your home’s windows.

Depending on your requirements and preferences you have the following film options to choose from:

  • Solar window films – reduces the amount of heat & glare that enters your home
  • Privacy films – stops those on the outside from seeing into your home during the day without reducing the amount of natural light that enters your home
  • Safety films – helps to keep you and your family safe from breakages and break-ins
  • Security films – 7 x stronger than standard film
  • Decorative films – adds a unique and stylish element to your home whilst also offering privacy for rooms like bathrooms

Our films also protect you and your family from harmful UV rays, help to reduce premature fading of floorings & furnishings and provide more comfortable year-round temperatures (you’ll notice that your home is cooler during summer and warmer in winter).

Your window tinting Townsville consultant can provide recommendations on the best films to use in different areas of your home such as security film for entrance areas and safety film for high traffic areas (e.g. bi-folding doors in a living area).

In addition to the benefits that home window tinting provides, we also offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications – which are done by professionally trained installers. Interest-free payment options are also available with Afterpay and ZipPay where you can split your purchase over 3,6,9, or 12 months with ZERO interest.

Contact Our Window Tinting Townsville Team Today

Use our Store Finderto find your local Townsville based window tinting store to arrange a free onsite measure and quote. If you’d like to know more about our films or window tinting Townsville services you can contact our customer service team on 13TINT.
